references.text: The preceding verse addressing the same theme of leaving parts of the harvest for the poor and foreigners
Repeats the command to leave remnants of the harvest for the poor and foreigners
Elaborates on the laws regarding leaving portions of the grain, olive, and grape harvests for widows, orphans, and foreigners
Ruth gleans in Boaz's field, a practical example of how this law was practiced
Boaz commands his servants to let Ruth glean freely, and even to pull out stalks from the sheaves for her
The command to be generous toward the poor in the land
Jesus' disciples pick grain on the Sabbath, a practice that was permitted for the poor
